note:
USACE campground on Mississippi River Pool 9 back channels near De Soto.  Several sites right on the channel.  --AWH
Two electric loops: Upper (39 sites) and West (34 sites; showers and flush toilets, sites 40-57 along the back channel). Sites 32/33, 35/36 and 38/39 share a driveway. Beach, two boat ramps, fishing docks and a fish cleaning station. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility, rates, campsite catalog, four months of availability and imagery read. Fees $18-26 confirmed (Nov-Dec electric $13). Booking rec.gov, 14-night max, non-electric FCFS-in-area (fcfs some_sites); season May 1 - Dec 31 (full campground to Oct 31, 11 West sites through December); 150 sites, 80-ft max; electric 50 confirmed; facilities added. --AWH riverfront unchanged and supported by the catalog (West 40-57 flagged Riverfront).
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH 'riverfront', not changed): agrees. rec.gov flags West loop sites 40 and 42-57 'Riverfront' (41 too, by 'Proximity to Water'), at 43.4567-43.4596,-91.2254 to -91.2262, along the back channel west of the loop; all are reservable nightly electric sites. Imagery at hw 450 m shows the West loop on a strip between the channel and the backwaters; channel width not measured against the 30 m creekside line, but --AWH stands.

Pin 43.4610,-91.2225 sits on the open day-use lot between the two loops: about 150 m from the Upper loop (site 1 at 43.4619,-91.2237) and about 400 m from the West loop centre (about 43.4583,-91.2257). The catalogued sites' centroid is 43.4596,-91.2245 (about 230 m SW of the pin), so no move over 250 m is needed; optional move to 43.4596,-91.2245.

Season: Jan-Apr 2027 is not yet released on rec.gov (no information). The 2025 rate table had a Non-Peak Jan 1 - Apr 14 season, the 2026 table none, so winter camping before May is unconfirmed; closes written as 12-31 from the open December calendar.
